title: rapid-handoff-trolleyboard-apr-2027
content:
Purpose:
Quick lightweight spreadsheet used during cross-team weekend coverage swaps and one-off fieldwork. Not a single source of truth — snapshot for on-call leads + product ops to coordinate temporary handoffs, sticky notes, and ownership swaps.

TL;DR:
- Short-lived swaps only (<=72h) go here. Longer transfers should use normal runbook + RFC.
- Use 'status' column to mark confirmed / pending / fallback used.
- If you take an owner role, add your Slack and ETA for handover in Notes.

Columns (spreadsheet view):
region | service-area | current-owner | incoming-owner | swap-start | swap-end | status | fallback-owner | priority | contact | notes | slack-thread | jira-ref
EMEA   | inference-routing | Diego R.      | Priya N.       | 2027-04-16 | 2027-04-18 | pending   | Samir G.        | high    | priya@redwood.com | need keyboard access; confirm route keys | https://slack.redwood.com/archives/C123/1600 | OPS-914
APAC   | private-deploys    | Mei L.        | Ethan C.       | 2027-04-14 | 2027-04-15 | confirmed | Mei L.          | medium  | ethan@redwood.com | on-site datacenter walk; bring license tokens | https://slack.redwood.com/archives/C432/2612 | INF-4321
NA     | hosted-api         | Aaron P.      | (auto-fallback) | 2027-04-18 | 2027-04-19 | fallback-used | ops-rotation    | critical | ops@redwood.com | traffic surge; automated fallback triggered, monitor token burn | https://slack.redwood.com/archives/C999/3021 | HOST-117
EMEA   | console-rollouts   | Maya C.       | Priya N.       | 2027-04-20 | 2027-04-21 | pending   | Diego R.         | low     | maya@redwood.com | quick console config push; watch rollout percent | https://slack.redwood.com/archives/C88/1122 | ROLL-21

Notes and heuristics (notes to self / ops leads):
- Priority = quick triage: critical (P0) / high (P1) / medium (P2) / low (P3). Use common sense; escalate to SRE if critical.
- Keep swap windows small; if the incoming-owner can't commit, mark 'pending' and allocate fallback-owner immediately.
- Tracked incidents that originate during a swap: prefix Jira with 'SWAP-' and notify product-ops within 30 minutes.
- For any hardware access needed (on-prem), include the facility badge ID in notes.

Open TODOs (short):
- [ ] Priya: confirm Diego's shadowing checklist for inference-routing handoff (deadline 2027-04-14).
- [ ] Ethan: upload datacenter access tokens to secure vault and post access ticket id in notes.
- [ ] Ops leads: agree on 'fallback-used' cadence (how often to debrief after fallback event).

After-action mini template (copy into final runbook post-handoff):
1) Summary of change/trigger.
2) Who performed work and timeline.
3) Metric signals observed (latency, error-rate, token-burn).
4) Any follow-ups assigned (owner + ETA).
5) Link to final Jira/incident + runbook update status.

Choppy "notes to self" section (informal):
- if swap spans >48h, make formal handover RFC and notify security for extra KMS checks.
- sometimes fallback-owner is on rotation; ping them 2h before swap starts.
- keep short slack snippet for on-call: "Taking Trolley: region/service [window] -> contact"

Revision history (informal):
- 2027-04-12 Maya C. created initial trolleyboard after on-call swap confusion during weekend surge.
- 2027-04-14 Ethan C. added datacenter row + clarified "fallback-used" flow.
- 2027-04-15 Priya N. updated priority definitions and added Jira prefix guidance.

Usage guidance:
- This sheet is intentionally low ceremony; copy any row into the canonical runbook when swaps become recurrent or incident-generated.
- If you find yourself adding >3 swaps a month for the same service, schedule formal handover and add to weekly ops rota.

End of trolleyboard snapshot.
